subject: PR-865 GitGuardian 37443000: SYNTHETIC fixture, not a live DSN. Do not rotate.
body:
OBSERVATION. packages/prediction-engine/src/edge-lab/__tests__/psql-readonly.test.ts at b71d9c04 contains a postgresql:// URL. I will not print it.

Classification: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE, not a live credential. Evidence, all measured from the test file itself:
- Host is ep-cool.neon.tech. Real Neon compute hosts are ep-<id>.<region>.aws.neon.tech (or similar region-qualified form). This host has no region and no aws. It is a cartoon Neon hostname.
- User is hermes_ro (named after the agent branch).
- Password is a 12-character leetspeak placeholder (matches /s3cret/), asserted as a string literal in two expect() calls. Real Neon passwords are generated tokens, not leetspeak.
- Database is neondb, Neon default, used as a shape not a target.

INFERENCE. GitGuardian and the repo Secret scan (full tree) matched the SHAPE postgresql://user:pass@*.neon.tech/neondb, not a verified live secret. The CWE-214 fix itself is correct (PG* env, argv is flags+SQL). The test reintroduced the class of problem it was remediating, one layer over: a test for credential HANDLING contained a credential SHAPE a scanner can match.

SPECULATION. Nothing in this file looks copy-pasted from a Neon dashboard. Rotation is not indicated from what I can see. Founder call on history rewrite; I will not rewrite b71d9c0.

Not rotating. Not printing the string. Next: replace with a sentinel that no scanner can match, then root-cause the other four red checks (guardrails, test/type/lint/prisma, FABLE, Codacy) independently of this finding.
